snippet.title: Guild Saga: Vanished Worlds - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016594

Guild Saga: Vanished Worlds is a fantasy RPG coming to PS5 in May 2027. Build your party, explore the Respite Archipelago, and combine skills across ten disciplines in tactical turn-based battles.

Wishlist now on the PlayStation Store!
